Coldtea in action

Every other agentic development environment optimizes how fast you write code

Speed stopped being the problem. The risk moved downstream, into regressions nobody caught and incidents your users report first

Coldtea covers what comes after

Coding agents build. QA agents verify every release. Monitoring agents watch production. One environment for end-to-end software delivery, not five

01/Terminal

## Run coding agents as a team [...] Free to get started. The terminal is free forever, agentic testing comes with a generous free tier, and production monitoring is free to try.

A wide range, from Sentry and Datadog to Grafana, New Relic, PostHog and Vercel. If yours is missing, request it from inside the app or emailhello@coldtea.ai. Adding a new provider usually takes us about 24 hours.

It uses your app the way a person would. For mobile, it spins up simulators and loads real builds. For web, it drives your live site, and on every pull request it runs against the preview URL so regressions are caught before they merge. Critical flows can be fully automated for release testing, on web and mobile.
